title: Yè Gōng hào lóng
simplified_paragraphs: 春秋时期，有一个人叫叶公，他非常喜欢龙。叶公家的大门、窗户、花园、石头、墙、家具全都有龙的图案。不但住的地方随时随地可以看到龙，他每天一有空就会写龙、画龙，连孩子们的名字都有“龙”。天上的龙被叶公感动了，决定到人间来见他，向他表示感谢。
有一天，叶公正在睡觉，屋子外面突然电闪雷鸣，风雨交加。叶公赶紧起来关窗户，这时候真正的龙从窗户外把头伸进来，他非常惊恐，转身往里跑，又看见一条巨大的龙尾巴。叶公发现自己无处可逃，就被吓晕了。龙看着晕倒的叶公，感到很失望，只好飞回天上去了。
后来人们用“叶公好龙”这个成语比喻一些人表里不一，看起来很喜欢某些东西，实际并不爱好，也不了解，甚至害怕它、反对它。
traditional_paragraphs: 春秋時期，有一個人叫葉公，他非常喜歡龍。葉公家的大門、窗戶、花園、石頭、牆、家具全都有龍的圖案。不但住的地方隨時隨地可以看到龍，他每天一有空就會寫龍、畫龍，連孩子們的名字都有“龍”。天上的龍被葉公感動了，決定到人間來見他，向他表示感謝。
有一天，葉公正在睡覺，屋子外面突然電閃雷鳴，風雨交加。葉公趕緊起來關窗戶，這時候真正的龍從窗戶外把頭伸進來，他非常驚恐，轉身往裡跑，又看見一條巨大的龍尾巴。葉公發現自己無處可逃，就被嚇暈了。龍看著暈倒的葉公，感到很失望，只好飛回天上去了。
後來人們用“葉公好龍”這個成語比喻一些人表裡不一，看起來很喜歡某些東西，實際並不愛好，也不瞭解，甚至害怕它、反對它。
pinyin_paragraphs: Chūn qiū shí qī， yǒu yī gè rén jiào Yè Gōng， tā fēi cháng xǐ huan lóng。 Yè Gōng jiā de dà mén、 chuāng hu、 huā yuán、 shí tou、 qiáng、 jiā jù quán dōu yǒu lóng de tú àn。 bù dàn zhù de dì fang suí shí suí dì kě yǐ kàn dào lóng， tā měi tiān yī yǒu kòng jiù huì xiě lóng、 huà lóng， lián hái zi men de míng zi dōu yǒu“ lóng”。 tiān shàng de lóng bèi Yè Gōng gǎn dòng le， jué dìng dào rén jiān lái jiàn tā， xiàng tā biǎo shì gǎn xiè。

yǒu yī tiān， Yè Gōng zhèng zài shuì jiào， wū zi wài miàn tū rán diàn shǎn léi míng， fēng yǔ jiāo jiā。 Yè Gōng gǎn jǐn qǐ lái guān chuāng hu， zhè shí hou zhēn zhèng de lóng cóng chuāng hu wài bǎ tóu shēn jìn lái， tā fēi cháng jīng kǒng， zhuǎn shēn wǎng lǐ pǎo， yòu kàn jiàn yī tiáo jù dà de lóng wěi ba。 Yè Gōng fā xiàn zì jǐ wú chù kě táo， jiù bèi xià yūn le。 lóng kàn zhe yūn dǎo de Yè Gōng， gǎn dào hěn shī wàng， zhǐ hǎo fēi huí tiān shàng qù le。
hòu lái rén men yòng“ Yè Gōng hào lóng” zhè gè chéng yǔ bǐ yù yī xiē rén biǎo lǐ bù yī， kàn qǐ lái hěn xǐ huan mǒu xiē dōng xi， shí jì bìng bù ài hào， yě bù liǎo jiě， shèn zhì hài pà tā、 fǎn duì tā。
english_paragraphs: During the Spring and Autumn Period, there was a man named Ye Gong who liked dragons very much. The doors, windows, gardens, stones, walls, and furniture of Ye Gong's house all have dragon patterns. Not only can you see dragons anytime and anywhere where he lives, he will write and draw dragons every day when he has free time. Even the names of his children have "dragon" in them. The dragon in the sky was moved by Ye Gong and decided to come to the world to see him and express his gratitude to him.

One day, while Ye Zhengzheng was sleeping, there was sudden thunder and lightning and wind and rain outside the house. Ye Gong quickly got up and closed the window. At this time, the real dragon stuck its head out of the window. He was very frightened, turned around and ran in, and saw a huge dragon tail again. When Ye Gong found that he had nowhere to escape, he was frightened and fainted. The dragon looked at the fainted Ye Gong and felt very disappointed, so he had to fly back to the sky.
Later, people used the idiom "Ye Gong loves dragons" to describe some people who seem to like something, but actually do not like it, do not understand it, or even fear it or oppose it.

Not only can you see dragons anytime and anywhere where he lives, he will write and draw dragons every day when he has free time. Even the names of his children have "dragon" in them. The dragon in the sky was moved by Ye Gong and decided to come to the world to see him and express his gratitude to him.

One day, while Ye Zhengzheng was sleeping, there was sudden thunder and lightning and wind and rain outside the house. Ye Gong quickly got up and closed the window. At this time, the real dragon stuck its head out of the window. He was very frightened, turned around and ran in, and saw a huge dragon tail again. When Ye Gong found that he had nowhere to escape, he was frightened and fainted. The dragon looked at the fainted Ye Gong and felt very disappointed, so he had to fly back to the sky.

Later, people used the idiom "Ye Gong loves dragons" to describe some people who seem to like something, but actually do not like it, do not understand it, or even fear it or oppose it.
